categories: below / near / above the middle third of 1981-2010 seasons
method: Trend-shifted climatology: tercile edges from the 1981-2010 seasons; the season's value is predicted from the Sen's-slope trend line fitted to all complete seasons before the cut-off, with a normal spread equal to the scatter around that line (prediction-interval widened). Precipitation is handled as SPI (gamma fit on 1981-2010). Each category is kept at 2% or more.
data: NASA POWER monthly T2M and PRECTOTCORR

P.not_issued: dry season: normal rainfall is close to zero, terciles are meaningless
